feed.title: Dengue Tracker: Europe
feed.subtitle: Independent, sourced tracker of locally acquired dengue in Europe in 2026: ECDC and national case counts, affected countries and clusters, the yearly trend since 2010, vaccines and a dated timeline.

entry.title: Italy: 68 local dengue cases in 5 outbreaks; France unchanged at 6
entry.summary: The ISS counts 346 confirmed dengue cases from 1 January to 6 October; 68 were locally acquired, linked to 5 outbreaks plus 1 case not linked to the others, and there were no deaths. One of 29 chikungunya cases was locally acquired. Santé publique France's 7 October bulletin (data to 5 October) still counts 4 local dengue episodes with 6 cases, and 20 local chikungunya episodes with 146 cases.
entry.content:
The ISS counts 346 confirmed dengue cases from 1 January to 6 October; 68 were locally acquired, linked to 5 outbreaks plus 1 case not linked to the others, and there were no deaths. One of 29 chikungunya cases was locally acquired. Santé publique France's 7 October bulletin (data to 5 October) still counts 4 local dengue episodes with 6 cases, and 20 local chikungunya episodes with 146 cases.

Sources: Quotidiano Sanità, AgenSIR, Santé publique France bulletin, 7 Oct

entry.title: Cartigliano cluster reaches 8 cases; Rome added to affected areas
entry.summary: The local health authority reports 8 locally acquired cases in Cartigliano; one older patient is in hospital as a precaution. Italy's National Blood Centre lists Rome as an area with local dengue from 2 October.
entry.content:
The local health authority reports 8 locally acquired cases in Cartigliano; one older patient is in hospital as a precaution. Italy's National Blood Centre lists Rome as an area with local dengue from 2 October.

Sources: TViWeb, ANSA Veneto, Italian National Blood Centre

entry.title: Italy: 59 local dengue cases, no deaths
entry.summary: The ISS counts 330 confirmed dengue cases from 1 January to 29 September; 59 were locally acquired and the rest linked to travel. One of 28 chikungunya cases was also locally acquired.
entry.content:
The ISS counts 330 confirmed dengue cases from 1 January to 29 September; 59 were locally acquired and the rest linked to travel. One of 28 chikungunya cases was also locally acquired.

Sources: Istituto Superiore di Sanità, Quotidiano Sanità, AgenSIR

entry.title: France: 6 local dengue cases; local chikungunya at 125
entry.summary: Santé publique France counts 4 dengue episodes with 6 cases and 424 imported dengue cases since 1 May. Separately (chikungunya, a different virus): 19 local episodes with 125 cases, including 6 in Nogent-sur-Marne (Val-de-Marne).
entry.content:
Santé publique France counts 4 dengue episodes with 6 cases and 424 imported dengue cases since 1 May. Separately (chikungunya, a different virus): 19 local episodes with 125 cases, including 6 in Nogent-sur-Marne (Val-de-Marne).

Sources: Santé publique France bulletin, 30 Sep

entry.title: First local case in Cartigliano, Veneto
entry.summary: A locally acquired case in Cartigliano (Vicenza) prompts mosquito control and blood-donation precautions. The local health authority reports two more cases on 29 September.
entry.content:
A locally acquired case in Cartigliano (Vicenza) prompts mosquito control and blood-donation precautions. The local health authority reports two more cases on 29 September.

Sources: Italian National Blood Centre, AgenSalute (ULSS 7), Il Giornale di Vicenza

entry.title: Italy reaches 47 local cases in three outbreaks
entry.summary: The ISS links them to outbreaks in the provinces of Livorno (28 cases), Lecce (13) and Milan (2); 4 cases have no known link. 312 dengue cases have been confirmed this year, with no deaths.
entry.content:
The ISS links them to outbreaks in the provinces of Livorno (28 cases), Lecce (13) and Milan (2); 4 cases have no known link. 312 dengue cases have been confirmed this year, with no deaths.

Sources: Quotidiano Sanità (24 Sep), ANSA, Sky TG24

entry.title: ECDC: Italy 37 and France 5 local cases
entry.summary: As of 16 September. Italy added 13 cases in a week: 6 near Lecce, 5 near Livorno and 2 in a new cluster near Milan. France had no new cases. ECDC will report weekly until November.
entry.content:
As of 16 September. Italy added 13 cases in a week: 6 near Lecce, 5 near Livorno and 2 in a new cluster near Milan. France had no new cases. ECDC will report weekly until November.

Sources: ECDC threats report, week 38

entry.title: Italy confirms its first local outbreaks of 2026
entry.summary: The ISS counts 24 locally acquired cases by 8 September, up from 3 on 30 August, in outbreaks in Livorno province (Tuscany) and Lecce province (Puglia). The other 241 of 265 confirmed cases were linked to travel; 56% of those with a known place of infection had been in the Maldives.
entry.content:
The ISS counts 24 locally acquired cases by 8 September, up from 3 on 30 August, in outbreaks in Livorno province (Tuscany) and Lecce province (Puglia). The other 241 of 265 confirmed cases were linked to travel; 56% of those with a known place of infection had been in the Maldives.

Sources: AgenSalute (ISS data), Italpress, Biomedical CuE, Sanità Informazione

entry.title: France reaches 5 cases, now including Bouches-du-Rhône
entry.summary: Bouches-du-Rhône (Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur) is added: France has 5 locally acquired cases across Tarn, Hérault, Dordogne and Bouches-du-Rhône.
entry.content:
Bouches-du-Rhône (Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur) is added: France has 5 locally acquired cases across Tarn, Hérault, Dordogne and Bouches-du-Rhône.

Sources: Santé publique France bulletin, 26 Aug, NaTHNaC (UK)

entry.title: France: 4 local cases, now including Dordogne
entry.summary: Santé publique France counts 3 transmission episodes with 4 cases, in Tarn, Hérault and Dordogne (Nouvelle-Aquitaine), and 308 imported dengue cases since 1 May.
entry.content:
Santé publique France counts 3 transmission episodes with 4 cases, in Tarn, Hérault and Dordogne (Nouvelle-Aquitaine), and 308 imported dengue cases since 1 May.

Sources: Santé publique France bulletin, 19 Aug

entry.title: France reports its first local dengue cases of 2026
entry.summary: Two unrelated locally acquired cases are confirmed in Occitanie: one in Carmaux (Tarn) and one in Hérault.
entry.content:
Two unrelated locally acquired cases are confirmed in Occitanie: one in Carmaux (Tarn) and one in Hérault.

Sources: Vidal, franceinfo, Outbreak News Today

entry.title: France starts its seasonal surveillance of dengue and chikungunya
entry.summary: Santé publique France begins enhanced surveillance of dengue, chikungunya and Zika in mainland France for the mosquito season. Its counts of imported cases run from this date.
entry.content:
Santé publique France begins enhanced surveillance of dengue, chikungunya and Zika in mainland France for the mosquito season. Its counts of imported cases run from this date.

Sources: Santé publique France bulletin, 30 Sep, Santé publique France: dengue data

entry.title: ECDC closes the 2025 season at 35 local cases
entry.summary: France reported 29 locally acquired cases, Italy 4 and Portugal's Madeira 2. With no new cases since late October and cooler weather, ECDC ended its weekly dengue reports for the year.
entry.content:
France reported 29 locally acquired cases, Italy 4 and Portugal's Madeira 2. With no new cases since late October and cooler weather, ECDC ended its weekly dengue reports for the year.

Sources: ECDC: seasonal dengue surveillance, ECDC: local dengue in the EU/EEA, previous years
